scenarios.title: Twin Sparks
scenarios.prophecy: The first peg your shot touches will echo the blow. Strike where pegs crowd and the echo spreads.
scenarios.debrief: Aim at a dense peg cluster on your next shot; the doubled first contact deals bonus damage right where pegs bunch together.

scenarios.title: Settled Grace
scenarios.prophecy: Fell a foe before the dust settles and a life returns to you. Let every settlement end in victory.
scenarios.debrief: Push damage hard before each settlement; defeating an enemy restores one life, so keep a kill within reach each round.

scenarios.title: Two Lives, All Edge
scenarios.prophecy: You begin with two lives and nothing held back. Every shot must land with purpose or the edge cuts you.
scenarios.debrief: Protect your two lives and favor steady damage; choose upgrades that keep your shots reliable over risky payoff.
